exit.name: AArch64 assembly Linux exit example
exit.body:
// GNU assembler, AArch64 Linux
.text
.global _start
_start:
    mov x0, #0
    mov x8, #93
    svc #0

bare-metal-startup.name: AArch64 single-core startup
bare-metal-startup.body:
// AArch64 single-core entry; firmware must supply executable RAM with MMU off.
// Requires writable RAM, matching linker script, and a valid current EL SP bank.
// No EL transition, vector setup, secondary-core release or constructors here.
.section .text.boot,"ax"
.balign 16
.global _start
_start:
    msr DAIFSet, #0xf
    ldr x0, =__stack_top
    mov sp, x0
    ldr x0, =__bss_start
    ldr x1, =__bss_end
1:  cmp x0, x1
    b.hs 2f
    str xzr, [x0], #8
    b 1b
2:  bl kernel_main
3:  wfi
    b 3b
